title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Non Decreasing
summary: Given an integer array nums, determine the least sum of increments needed to ensure the array is non-decreasing.
statement: Given an integer array nums, determine the least sum of increments needed to ensure the array is non-decreasing. An increment operation involves selecting any subarray and increasing its elements by a positive integer x. The goal is to make nums[i] <= nums[i+1] for all i.
constraints: An operation adds any positive integer x to every value in one nonempty subarray.
Minimize the sum of all chosen x values needed to make nums nondecreasing.
reference_solution:
def minimum_nondecreasing_increment_cost(nums):
    return sum(max(nums[i]-nums[i+1],0) for i in range(len(nums)-1))
hints: Each downward adjacent gap must be repaired.
One suffix increment can repair exactly the gap at its left boundary.
Every drop supplies a lower bound, and applying those increments to matching suffixes attains it.
editorial: Every drop supplies a lower bound, and applying those increments to matching suffixes attains it.

tests.explanation: The drops 3-to-2 and 2-to-1 each require one unit, for total cost two.
Raising the suffix beginning at one by four makes the array nondecreasing.
